name: sanser
description: Sanser 2.0.0 low-latency remote desktop and game streaming platform.

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:stage-sidecar && node scripts/run-with-cargo-env.mjs npm --workspace @sanser/desktop run tauri -- dev
scripts.desktop:bundle: npm run release:validate && npm run desktop:stage-sidecar && node scripts/run-with-cargo-env.mjs npm --workspace @sanser/desktop run tauri -- build
scripts.desktop:bundle:local: node scripts/validate-release-config.mjs --allow-loopback && npm run desktop:stage-sidecar && node scripts/run-with-cargo-env.mjs npm --workspace @sanser/desktop run tauri -- build
scripts.check: npm run desktop:stage-sidecar && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs fmt --check && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && npm run desktop:check && npm run desktop:lint
scripts.test: npm run desktop:stage-sidecar && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs test --workspace && npm run desktop:test
scripts.build: npm run desktop:stage-sidecar && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs build --workspace --release && npm run desktop:build
scripts.native:protocol:test: cmake -S native/protocol -B native/protocol/build -DBUILD_TESTING=ON && cmake --build native/protocol/build --config Release && ctest --test-dir native/protocol/build --output-on-failure
